description:
Pay Rate: $99-$100/Hr

About Client:
The client is a leading American biopharmaceutical company. It specializes in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapeutics, particularly in antiviral drugs for HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, and influenza. Known for key products like Truvada, Biktarvy, and Sovaldi, it invests heavily in research and development to address unmet medical needs. The company also focuses on expanding its portfolio through strategic acquisitions and collaborations, while maintaining a commitment to improving global health and access to medications.

Responsibilities:
  • Drive alignment across program interdependencies and portfolio-level goals.
  • Partner with PTL and Development Lead to execute program strategy.
  • Lead goal setting, progress tracking, and outcome communication across teams and stakeholders.
  • Ensure data accuracy and timeline integrity within enterprise portfolio and timeline systems.
  • Responsible for maintaining accurate and current program information across online systems and dashboards.
  • Elevate and track risks, ensuring mitigation plans are in place.
  • Prepare teams for governance engagements (Portfolio Committee, Development Review Committee), ensuring readiness and alignment.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong foundation in project management principles; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Extensive experience in project management within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Deep functional expertise in at least one domain: Research, Development, or Commercialization.
  • Solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle, experience in Early Development strong preferred.
  • Oncology and cell therapy experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and foster strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into actionable insights.

  • Experience with Planisware or similar enterprise project portfolio management tools preferred.

About Client:
Company is a worldwide provider of legal services, serving law firms, corporations, financial institutions and government agencies—helping them streamline the administration of business operations.
Its scalable, flexible technology is designed to help you quickly and efficiently turn huge amounts of data into manageable, actionable tools you can use to meet a variety of objectives.



Rate Range: $42-$45/Hr



Job Description:
  • The Instructional Designer will collaborate with subject matter experts and other stakeholders to conduct needs assessments, identify appropriate learning/training approaches, and develop compelling learning activities and course content.
Essential Job Responsibilities:
  • Create and update digital, visual, and audio interactive learning/training assets including end-user and process documentation.
  • Lead or support instructor-led trainings with varying audience sizes and complexity.
  • Evaluate feedback and performance data to continuously improve content effectiveness and delivery.
  • Foster a collaborative, productive learning/training environment that captures the audience’s attention to help them meet learning objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand on learning analytics.
Qualifications and Requirements:
  • 3+ years of instructional design/development or comparative and demonstrable experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in MS365 and eLearning authoring tools.
  • Ability to management multiple projects concurrently.
Preferred but not required:
  • MS Dynamics, specifically Project Operations o Learning Management System (LMS) administration experience
  • Basic knowledge of adult learning theories and instructional design methodologies o Fundamental understanding of HTML, HTML5, SCORM, and MV4
Key Competencies:
  • Building Effective Relationships: Identifies opportunities to build strategic relationships with individuals in other areas of the business to achieve business goals.
  • Managing Change: Facilitates the implementation and acceptance of organizational change. Addresses resistance to change and helps individuals adapt to change.
  • Strategic Agility: Clearly understands and articulates the business strategy, continuously ensures team and individual goals are aligned to broader strategic objectives, particularly when there is a change in direction.
  • Influencing Others: Uses appropriate interpersonal styles to persuade others to accept a position or initiative that results in action to positively impact business results. Assesses the current situation and adapts interpersonal style to suit the target audience.
  • Cross-Organizational Collaboration: Expands the organization’s ability to operate effectively in multiple environments through strategic collaboration with other business units and business leaders.
  • Diversity Champion: Designs training materials to be inclusive of different cultures and backgrounds.
Work Environment:
  • Work is fast paced with extensive contact with clients and colleagues. The industry we serve demands the highest level of confidentiality and professionalism in safeguarding client and project information. Highly effective Training Experience Designers thrive on being in an environment that rewards the following critical success factors:
  • Adaptability: Appropriately reacting to changing situations without a loss of effectiveness and enthusiasm for strategic initiatives and corporate goals.
  • Analysis: Identifying problems and causes or analyzing how processes and procedures could be improved, collecting relevant information, and identifying workable solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Appropriately completing all the individual tasks accurately or according to workflow/process guidelines with an emphasis on reaching or exceeding quality standards.
  • Creativity: Being inventive, imaginative, and innovative.
  • Energy: Maintaining a fast, active pace in the normal course of a day.
  • Flexibility: Going into situations without preconceived notions with a willingness to assess various options to determine a course of action.
